groups.label: Scene
groups.description: Explore the scene conditions represented in InsertWorld.

categories.label: Strong light
categories.description: Direct light creates pronounced highlights and cast shadows.

images.alt: Sunlit interior with strong window light and sharp shadows

categories.label: Mirrors
categories.description: Mirrors introduce reflected views of objects and the surrounding scene.

images.alt: Interior with a large wall mirror

categories.label: Reflective surfaces
categories.description: Glossy surfaces reflect nearby objects and illumination.

images.alt: Glossy table surface reflecting nearby objects

categories.label: Low light
categories.description: Dim scenes require matching low illumination and local light sources.

categories.label: Perspective
categories.description: Scene geometry provides perspective cues for object placement.

images.alt: Interior with receding architectural lines and arched windows

categories.label: Colored lighting
categories.description: Colored illumination changes the appearance of scene and object materials.

images.alt: Miniature scene illuminated with violet and warm colored light

groups.label: Object
groups.description: Explore object geometry and surface appearance.

categories.label: Deformable
categories.description: Flexible objects include fabric and foliage.

categories.label: Rigid
categories.description: Rigid objects retain their shape during placement.

categories.label: Smooth
categories.description: Smooth surfaces produce coherent highlights and reflections.

categories.label: Rough
categories.description: Rough surfaces have visible texture and diffuse highlights.

categories.label: Transparent
categories.description: Transparent objects transmit light and reveal background appearance.

images.alt: Bowl shown in the transparency examples

categories.label: Metal
categories.description: Metallic surfaces reflect the color and lighting of their surroundings.

images.alt: Reflective spherical ornament on a stand

categories.label: Emissive
categories.description: Emissive objects act as local light sources.
